시편 122:1.content: A Song of degrees of David. I was glad when they said unto me, Let us go into the house of the Lord.

시편 122:2.content: Our feet shall stand within thy gates, O Jerusalem.

시편 122:3.content: Jerusalem is builded as a city that is compact together:

시편 122:4.content: Whither the tribes go up, the tribes of the Lord, unto the testimony of Israel, to give thanks unto the name of the Lord.

시편 122:5.content: For there are set thrones of judgment, the thrones of the house of David.

시편 122:6.content: Pray for the peace of Jerusalem: they shall prosper that love thee.

시편 122:7.content: Peace be within thy walls, and prosperity within thy palaces.

시편 122:8.content: For my brethren and companions’ sakes, I will now say, Peace be within thee.

시편 122:9.content: Because of the house of the Lord our God I will seek thy good.
